implementation_evidence: plugin_workbench.py and sandbox/plugin_contracts.py execute actual Python tool, channel, skill and persona interfaces, plus source-pinned bundled Node NDJSON and local Python/Node gRPC servers inside the existing immutable research container. Schema, admission-denial, expected-result, timeout/cancel observation and cleanup receipts are version/image/harness specific.

plugin_execution_pins.py binds task and direct-flow execution to durable owner/revision/version fingerprints before import or construction and at dispatch; cached Python drift, changed source or revoked policy fail closed. Native authorized task/flow pin migration retains history and never resumes or replays work.

Plugins native controls and product_operations_plugins.py provide the same governed status/check/cancel/publish/migrate operations to explicitly enabled Copilot with fresh review, current authority and durable recovery receipts; installer/settings expose the existing workbench and added Plugins action family.

grpc_plugin_host.py owns subprocess trees, bounds RPC and process output, propagates cancellation, and emits typed unknown-outcome receipts without retrying a possible Call. Malformed or missing terminal results cannot be reported as successful.

docs/plugin-qualification-workbench.md documents supported executable contracts, immutable-image prerequisites, honest fast-completion interruption observations, publication scope and affected-work migration.
validation: Final focused Python regression run: 91 passed (gRPC host, plugin contracts/workbench/loaders/lock, NDJSON host, native/Copilot adapters). Mocked transports and trusted local fixture subprocesses only.

Existing flow execution/hardening and TS host regression run: 93 passed, 2 SDK-build-dependent tests initially skipped; after building the SDK, both previously skipped actual Node interoperability tests passed. SDK npm test: 24 passed.
Python 3.10 AST parsing, Ruff on changed Python files, standalone JavaScript syntax and git diff --check passed after correcting fixture import ordering.
remaining: Controlled immutable-container qualification and installed-service acceptance remain unexecuted locally. Image must already contain the exact plugin/runtime dependencies, JSON Schema extra and (for gRPC) generated stubs; no live provider or external service was contacted.

Connection-only gRPC servers and arbitrary multi-file/argument-heavy Node or gRPC launchers need an exact reviewed bundled local entry before qualification; they are explicitly blocked rather than represented as a verified version.

Publication records whether timeout/cancellation interrupted dispatch or the exact result finished first; fast completion is never claimed as observed interruption. Customer acceptance should include a deliberately slow synthetic sample where the plugin supports one.
